newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot rises after strong Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot rises after strong Q1 results.

text.p: Shares of Home Depot Inc rose in heavy trading on the New York Stock Exchange after the do-it-yourself retailer of home improvement items posted strong first quarter earnings on Tuesday.
Shares rose 3/8 to 61-1/8, with the stock on the list of most active NYSE issues. On Tuesday, Home Depot posted earnings and sales that beat Wall Street expectations.
The company posted earnings of $0.53 a share compared with $0.41 last year, ahead of estimates of $0.51 a share. Same-store sales rose 11 percent.
"We continue to believe Home Depot can grow earnings per share 20 percent or more a year for four years," said William Julian, an analyst who tracks Home Depot for Lehman Brothers.
"While sales productivity may decline in the second half of 1997, we believe programs in place will reduce expenses faster and therefore bolster the operating margin," he said in a report.
